Object storage service: daily challenge, 2027-02-14

The shared System Designer challenge for 2027-02-14: Object storage service. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free, no sign-up.

Open the challenge

Customers store billions of files, from tiny pictures to huge videos, and fetch them by name. The service must never lose a file, scale without a limit and stay cheap. Most files are written once and rarely read again.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.
